# Berlin Swim Times

> Public swimming times at Berlin's public indoor pools (Berliner Bäder-Betriebe) for today and the next 6 days, refreshed daily from berlinerbaeder.de. German and English. Last update: 2026-10-17T07:44:45.256Z.

Each pool page states, per day, when public swimming takes place and whether the whole pool or only a reduced area is available. Times are as published by Berliner Bäder-Betriebe; their website is authoritative.

## Overview
- [Übersicht (Deutsch)](https://berlin-swim-times.johannesotterbach.com/): all pools, 7-day table
- [Overview (English)](https://berlin-swim-times.johannesotterbach.com/en/): all pools, 7-day table
